messages:
allhands-bot: Live chat is open! Drop your reactions, gifs, and the best one-liners. We'll read a few out loud. :tada:
Maya: that piano guy was stealing my soul 😂 :clap::clap:
Sam: can we get a replay link? my camera froze during the demo :eyes:
Jorge: replay posted: https://redwood.example/s/allhands/replay.mp4 
Lex: +1 to the replay, also voting 'Most Likely to Ship' award goes to infra team :trophy:
Ryan: infra gang wins. pancakes for everyone? 🥞 (virtual pancake emoji flood incoming) :pancakes:
Anya: pancakes AND moon-themed stickers. now this is peak company culture 🌝🥞
Kevin: who brought the kazoo? I heard a kazoo solo in the hallway earlier :notes:
Tara: that was me. kazoo practice for the victory march. :sunglasses:
Maya: shoutout to Priya for the clean slides and to backend for not melting down :sparkles: :heart_eyes:
Sam: reaction train :thumbsup: :thumbsup: :thumbsup:
Jorge: poll: after-party snack — sweet or savory? respond with emoji. 🍪 = sweet, 🧀 = savory
Lex: :cheese: (always cheese)
Kevin: :cookie: (counterpoint)
Ryan: :cheese: but also coffee please ☕
Anya: also tiny applause for the new hiring pipeline, looked sharp :clap:
allhands-bot: Quick note: survey link in threads for feedback — 2 mins to fill! https://redwood.example/s/allhands/survey
Tara: okay but who approved the 'moon pancake' sticker idea. need one on my laptop immediately :laptop:
Maya: tagging @Design — you heard the people :point_up:
Sam: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheering-team-enthusiasm-1.png (tense applause)
Jorge: anyone want to join the post-allhands ukulele jam in #random? zero skill required, enthusiasm only :ukulele:
Lex: I have one chord. it's called 'let-s-just-ship' :laughing:
Ryan: final thought — best tagline heard today: 'Serve brains, not just bytes' — can we make that a sticker too? :brain:
Anya: end of thread, but the pancake-emoji flood continues. :pancakes::pancakes::pancakes:
